query:
-- TX-1: D Primary Runoff (Prince vs Alexander), R nominee is N. Moran
UPDATE house_races SET 
  status = 'Primary Runoff',
  candidate1_name = 'Y. Prince → D. Alexander (D Runoff)',
  candidate1_party = 'D',
  candidate2_name = 'N. Moran',
  candidate2_party = 'R'
WHERE state_code = 'TX' AND district = '1';

-- TX-5: D Primary Runoff (Hockett vs Torres), R nominee is Lance Gooden
UPDATE house_races SET 
  status = 'Primary Runoff',
  candidate1_name = 'C. Hockett → R. Torres (D Runoff)',
  candidate1_party = 'D',
  candidate2_name = 'Lance Gooden',
  candidate2_party = 'R'
WHERE state_code = 'TX' AND district = '5';

-- TX-7: R Primary Runoff (Hale vs Cohen), D nominee is Lizzie Fletcher
UPDATE house_races SET 
  status = 'Primary Runoff',
  candidate1_name = 'Lizzie Fletcher',
  candidate1_party = 'D',
  candidate2_name = 'A. Hale → T. Cohen (R Runoff)',
  candidate2_party = 'R'
WHERE state_code = 'TX' AND district = '7';

-- TX-9: R Primary Runoff (Mealer vs Cain), D nominee is Lorenzo Gutierrez
UPDATE house_races SET 
  status = 'Primary Runoff',
  candidate1_name = 'Lorenzo Gutierrez',
  candidate1_party = 'D',
  candidate2_name = 'A. Mealer → B. Cain (R Runoff)',
  candidate2_party = 'R'
WHERE state_code = 'TX' AND district = '9';

-- TX-14: Check if this is a D runoff or general
UPDATE house_races SET 
  status = 'Primary Runoff',
  candidate1_name = 'T. Bartie → R. Davis (D Runoff)',
  candidate1_party = 'D'
WHERE state_code = 'TX' AND district = '14';

SELECT state_code, district, status, candidate1_name, candidate1_party, candidate2_name, candidate2_party 
FROM house_races WHERE state_code = 'TX' AND district IN ('1','5','7','9','14') ORDER BY CAST(district AS UNSIGNED);
